title: Coherent derived Hom for bounded-above and bounded-below algebraic complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $K,L\in D(A)$, the ordinary module derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume that every $H^j(K)$ and $H^j(L)$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and that there exist integers $u,v$ such that $H^j(K)=0$ for $j>u$ and $H^j(L)=0$ for $j<v$. Then every cohomology module of $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L)$ is finitely generated, and $H^r(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L))=0$ for $r<v-u$. Here $R\operatorname{Hom}_A$ is the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site with coefficient ring $A$.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof: the explicitly stated algebra problem for L in D^+_Coh(A) and K in D^-_Coh(A), with its lower bound v-u from the displayed bounded spectral sequences.

proof.text: Fix bounds $u,v$ as in the hypothesis. For every integer $q$, apply [lem-trf-finite-module-target-rhom] to $K$ and $N=H^q(L)$. Its hypotheses hold because $A$ is Noetherian, the cohomology of $K$ is finite and vanishes above $u$, and $H^q(L)$ is finite. Thus every $H^p(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,H^q(L)[0]))$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof: the algebra problem and the two displayed Ext spectral sequences.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-bounded-above-rhom-hyperext] on the one-object identity-covering site with coefficient ring $A$, taking $r=u$ and $c=v$. On this site sheaves of modules are ordinary $A$-modules, with the same cochain complexes, differentials and quasi-isomorphisms. The Hom-complex/K-injective formula of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] is therefore precisely the derived Hom used here. The two bounds are exactly the hypotheses on $K,L$. We obtain the $A$-linear spectral sequence $$E_2^{p,q}=H^p(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,H^q(L)[0]))\ \Longrightarrow\ H^{p+q}(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L)),$$ supported in $p\geq-u$, $q\geq v$, with finite exhaustive separated abutment filtrations and graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$.

source.place: Tag 0D0C, lemma-coherent-internal-hom, proof: the algebra problem and the two displayed Ext spectral sequences.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-noetherian-quadrant-abutment] to this sequence with $a=-u$, $b=v$ and $T^n=H^n(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L))$. Step 1 supplies finite generation of every second-page term; Step 2 supplies the support, differential and filtered-abutment hypotheses. The cited lemma gives finite generation of each $T^n$ and $T^n=0$ for $n<a+b=v-u$, proving both assertions.
